review_corrections.reviewer_verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED — nine findings, consolidated into one correction cycle
review_corrections.B1_nul_byte: CRITICAL. The preamble sentinel was \u0000preamble, which rendered a NUL byte into the prompt. The prompt is an argv element, so spawnSync throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE and dispatch crashes rather than dropping a line — strictly worse than the bug being fixed, and affecting the 5 of 60 live issues with pre-heading content. Sentinel is now a plain reserved string, and renderTaskContract strips control characters defensively so no future sentinel or pasted issue content can reintroduce one.
review_corrections.B2_claude_dry_run: claude-exec --dry-run resolved the packet before its dry-run branch, making a live Linear call and writing a git-tracked sync file in the shared control checkout — including while delegation is suspended. codex-exec already guarded this; claude-exec did not. Now guarded identically.
review_corrections.B3_sha_binding: Proof declared a MERGE_SHA at which neither correction exists. Set to N/A pre-merge; CI rebinds post-merge.
review_corrections.B4_vacuous_tests: Neither authored correction had a test. Removing either left the suite green. Five regression guards added; mutation-proven: removing preamble capture fails test 30, removing unmapped_sections validation fails test 33, removing empty-heading residue fails test 32.
review_corrections.B5_dry_run_overclaim: The unqualified dry-run purity claim measured only codex-exec. Scoped and the Claude path fixed.
review_corrections.B6_empty_heading: A section whose body was empty was discarded entirely, taking its heading text with it — "## DO NOT TOUCH PRODUCTION" followed by a subheading lost the prohibition vocabulary. The heading is now carried as residue.
review_corrections.B7_stale_cache: A persisted contract was served without revalidation, so a PM correction posted as a description edit was invisible forever, while the prompt told the executor not to look elsewhere. The render now carries Source issue and Captured at so staleness is visible. Full re-fetch-and-compare is recorded as a follow-up rather than widened into this lane.

second_cycle.B2_regression: The first correction imported generateExecutionPacket from node:child_process instead of ./execution-packet.js, so claude-exec --dry-run threw immediately, and its error handler threw too because printDryRun was called with one argument where it takes two, hidden by an `as never` cast. codex-exec called the function with no import at all, inherited from the preserved head. Both fixed; tsc confirms zero unresolved-symbol diagnostics on either entrypoint.
second_cycle.executing_coverage: Both entrypoints are now exported and covered by tests that EXECUTE the dry-run control flow. Mutation-proven: reintroducing the wrong-module import fails the DRY_RUN test with "got PRECONDITION_FAILED"; reintroducing the wrong-arity call fails the failure-path test; removing either import fails the narrow compile smoke control.
second_cycle.compile_smoke: A narrow compile control runs tsc over only the two executor entrypoints and asserts zero TS2304/TS2305 diagnostics. It does not pull the scripts tree into project references. Scoped to unresolved-symbol errors so pre-existing module-format noise cannot make it flap.
second_cycle.vacuous_tests_found_and_fixed: Two tests written during this cycle were themselves vacuous -- they exited before the packet path and passed under mutation. Both were replaced with tests that reach the code path. Recorded because the failure class recurred inside its own fix.
